title: Download scoped quotation currency summaries as Excel
description: A salesperson downloads only the all-matching per-currency summaries from the quotation designer without mistaking a current detail page for the full result. Add a dedicated summary Excel endpoint to the existing controller that reruns the exact validated and freshly authorized preview path and uses ERP-209 summaries; never accept client totals, fetch unscoped data or export all raw quotation rows. Use existing ExcelExporter with typed counts/decimal metrics, selected summary metric order and formula-safe labels/filter context. State date/customer/keyword/currency filters, all-matching scoped bounded-source coverage and original-currency evidence; unknown currencies remain separate and no cross-currency grand money total exists. The designer uses current fields/filters and clearly distinguishes summary download from existing current-page Excel. Invalid/revoked/source-overflow calls return no workbook. Development only: reuse current authenticated ERP identity, the existing quotation menu and freshly resolved SalespersonDataScopeService; audit every endpoint through existing OperationLogMiddleware. No permission expansion, arbitrary/model-generated SQL, direct table or business writes, new entities or persistence schema, migrations, schema/view/stored-procedure edits, production SQL or real database execution, secrets/.env changes, deployment, irreversible operations or real browser acceptance. Preserve unrelated modules and work. Run focused in-memory/service/API/export/UI source-contract tests and configured safe Release build/test; mark unavailable external environments blocked rather than inventing success.
acceptance_criteria: A dedicated summary Excel endpoint revalidates current request, quotation-menu access and ERP customer scope and uses server-derived all-matching per-currency summaries; revoked/invalid/source-limit calls return no file.

Workbook contains only selected summary metrics with typed numeric cells, formula-safe text, explicit normalized filter/date/coverage context and separate unknown currency; no unselected money, raw detail rows or cross-currency money total is exported.
Designer sends current fields and filters to summary Excel and shows errors while preserving existing detail export; focused workbook/UI and safe Release build/test pass.
